name: On First Window Open
purpose: File option trigger that runs when the first window of the file opens (not when another file opens it in the background): calls Startup OnFirstWindowOpen Trigger.
open_question: Effect depends on script 482 (Startup OnFirstWindowOpen Trigger), which is outside this batch.

name: On Last Window Close
purpose: File option trigger that runs when the last window closes: calls Shutdown OnLastWindowClose Trigger. Seven further steps (go to Dashboard layout, hide toolbars, resize window) are disabled.
open_question: Effect depends on script 483 (Shutdown OnLastWindowClose Trigger), which is outside this batch.

name: Commander
purpose: Developer/admin command dispatcher: evaluates the script parameter (Let notation) into $command and runs it: open Manage Database, File Options, Data Sources, Script Workspace or Layouts, bring to front, hide, reset an account password, delete an account, deactivate an account, return the file version (GetVersion), or open the sync log. Called by URL from a developer utility file and by Perform Script (karbon_Build Get Actual File Versions).
writes:
account: Reset Account Password for $AccountName (step 24, by name)
account: Delete Account for $AccountName (step 26, by name)
account: deactivate $AccountName (Enable Account step 28, by name)
callers: none found (called by URL from a developer file or by name, see karbon_Build 348)
external:
Evaluate of script parameter (step 6)
Open Manage Database / File Options / Data Sources / Script Workspace / Layouts (steps 10-18)
Reset Account Password (step 24)
Delete Account (step 26)
Enable Account [Deactivate] (step 28)
open_question: secret: step 24 resets an account password from $NewPassword (set by the caller through the evaluated parameter). Step 6 uses Evaluate on the whole parameter, so any calculation passed in is executed. Account commands (steps 24-28) give an admin API over file accounts. No DDR caller; relied on by karbon_Build (dropped) and external URLs.
